Module ingsw.myshelfie
Package it.polimi.myshelfie.controller

Class LobbyControllerImpl

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.myshelfie.controller.LobbyControllerImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
ChatController, LobbyController
public class LobbyControllerImpl extends Object implements LobbyController, ChatController
It allows to exit a lobby, add players to it, start the game if the player is the room owner and add observers.

    • addPlayer

      protected void addPlayer(Client client, ServerConnectionHandler connectionHandler, ClientExceptionsNotifier exceptionsNotifier, String playerName) throws InvalidParameterException, LobbyFullException
      Adds a player to the game.
      Parameters:
      client - represents the player.
      connectionHandler - the ServerConnectionHandler used for the player's connection.
      exceptionsNotifier - the client exception notifier of this client.
      playerName - the name of the player that must be added to the lobby.
      Throws:
      InvalidParameterException - if the playerName is not available.
      LobbyFullException - if the lobby is full.
